title: The Betty Boop cartoon and the short Rhapsody in Black and Blue
summary: The band recorded a Betty Boop cartoon and a short with Sidney Easton in Long Island, including High Society and a spear-throwing scene.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: The band also did a recording for a Betty Boop cartoon, didn't it?
That was Long Island. A Betty Boop cartoon, and we did a short, 'Rhapsody in Black and Blue', with Sidney Easton.
Yeah. What were some of the tunes that you did for the Betty Boop cartoon and for the short?
I believe "High Society" was on that. Because we had -- when we was said, ya ta ta, they had the spear shooting somebody, they had the spear going.
Da ta ta, whee-oo, and that spear would go up, go out there.
